name: CRTFE-HCM canonical finite ladder
nodes: V[0]..V[N-1]; C_n(t) from each node to ground
series_path: source/ZL -> node 0 -> L_0 -> node 1 -> ... -> node N-1 -> L_(N-1) -> ZR/right source
important: There are N capacitors AND N series inductors. The final inductor L_(N-1) feeds the right termination. A 48-C/47-L ladder is a different topology.
port_waves: a=(v+Z*i)/2, b=(v-Z*i)/2 with i defined into the device at each port
